body: A crate tally includes the offices but lists no contents; the next page labels the same shipment for a field check.
title: Crates without contents

cites.quote: crates all around, could be filled with stuff

gloss: A field check is linked to crates whose contents were never recorded.
rival_reading: An emergency storage count could list crates without contents; the tally does not identify the shipment.

title: Crates reserved for field samples
body: Warehouse note: keep the empty crates for soil cores from the southern trial farms. Three returned damp and smelling of solvent, though the manifest lists them unused.
rival_reading: A disaster-response worker could have made the same observation; this personal paper does not identify who directed the work.

title: Railyard pickup before dawn
body: Diary entry: the railyard pickup carried seed sacks and rinse drums before dawn. By breakfast the switchman’s eyes burned; the public closure came later.
rival_reading: A disaster-response worker could have made the same observation; this personal paper does not identify who directed the work.

title: Muldraugh route crossed out
body: Driver’s torn page: the Muldraugh route was crossed out after the field team reported foam in the drainage ditch. No replacement destination appears.
rival_reading: A disaster-response worker could have made the same observation; this personal paper does not identify who directed the work.

title: Muldraugh field route in the margin
body: Driver’s diary: beside the Muldraugh label, the return route from the southern trial farms is written in pencil. Two stops are rubbed out, but their sample counts remain.
rival_reading: A disaster-response worker could have made the same observation; this personal paper does not identify who directed the work.

title: Office ledger with no owner
body: Notebook from the offices: four crop-test invoices, no company name, all paid in cash. A pencil note says the county men collected the carbon copies.

title: Warehouse bay washed twice
body: Cleaning receipt: warehouse bay three was washed twice after storing pasture-treatment drums. The second wash is billed before the first crew signed out.
rival_reading: A disaster-response worker could have made the same observation; this personal paper does not identify who directed the work.

title: Trains idle after the shipment
body: Personal rail log: none of the trains would start after the trial shipment arrived. The same oily grit coated each air intake, but the repair report calls it ordinary dust.
rival_reading: A disaster-response worker could have made the same observation; this personal paper does not identify who directed the work.
